keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! Querétaro 1, Necaxa 0. Alí Ávila (Querétaro) header from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Mateo Coronel with a cross.
Goal! Querétaro 1, Necaxa 1. Emilio Rodríguez (Necaxa) left footed shot from outside the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Diego Ochoa.
Delay in match because of an injury Danny Leyva (Necaxa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Querétaro. Santiago Homenchenko replaces Jesús Arellano.
Second Half begins Querétaro 1, Necaxa 1.
Substitution, Querétaro. Álex Alcalá replaces Iker Benito.
Delay in match because of an injury Danny Leyva (Necaxa).
Delay in match (Querétaro). VAR checking.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Lucas Abascia (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Necaxa. Juan Valencia replaces Owen González.
Substitution, Necaxa. Matías Espíndola replaces Lorenzo Faravelli.
Substitution, Querétaro. Bayron Duarte replaces Denilson Muñoz.
Goal! Querétaro 2, Necaxa 1. Enzo Giménez (Querétaro) right footed shot from outside the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Carlo García.
Substitution, Necaxa. Javier Ruiz replaces Diego Ochoa.
Substitution, Querétaro. Carlos Villanueva replaces Alí Ávila.
Substitution, Querétaro. Edison Gruezo replaces Paulo Victor.
Diego Reyes (Querétaro) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Javier Orantes (Necaxa).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Querétaro 2, Necaxa 2. Julián Carranza (Necaxa) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Necaxa. Leonardo Arvizo replaces Danny Leyva.
Substitution, Necaxa. Omar Domínguez replaces Mauro Zaleta.
Second Half ends, Querétaro 2, Necaxa 2.
